summary: Full e2e testing of SFR Espace Client. Backend: 18/18 pytest tests pass (auth, forgot password/identifier, reset password, invoices, payments success/failure, PDF receipt, protected endpoints). Frontend: all critical UI flows verified with Playwright (login success + error message, Remember me -> localStorage vs sessionStorage, session persists across reload, forgot password + forgot identifier success screens, reset password mismatch and invalid token errors, invoice list rendering with pay/receipt buttons, client-side validation blocking submit, payment failure card 4000...0002 shows failure screen + retry, payment success card 4242 shows success screen with reference/amount/invoice#/masked IBAN, invoice flips to Payée, protected route redirects to /login, dashboard summary counters).

ui_bugs.issue:
Only the card-number error uses data-testid='payment-field-error'. The expiry and CVV inline error

elements are missing this data-testid, causing testability inconsistency (spec mentions inline field errors). Errors are shown visually and block submit — functional behaviour is correct, only test-ID is missing on 2 of 3 error fields.

action_items:
Optional (LOW): add data-testid={PAYMENT.errorField} to the expiry and CVV inline error

tags in Payment.jsx for consistent testability.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend server.py is ~520 lines and mixes auth, invoices, payments, PDF generation, seeding — consider splitting into routers/modules if the app grows.
seed() unconditionally re-inserts invoices only if count==0 — good idempotency for the seed user; password of seeded user is re-synced with env if changed, which matches the auth playbook guidance.
Payment simulation validation is duplicated between frontend (Payment.jsx luhnValid + expiry/cvv regex) and backend (server.py) — acceptable but consider extracting shared rules.
APP_URL falls back to http://localhost:3000 if env missing; in production this could produce broken reset links — good it is set in backend/.env.
public_invoice / public_user helpers correctly strip mongo _id.
receipt.pdf endpoint returns 400 when invoice not paid — good UX, matches spec.

context_for_next_testing_agent:
All e2e flows pass. If retesting UI payment flow, first drop the invoices collection (or reseed) since prior runs paid all unpaid invoices. Storage key is 'sfr_token' (not 'token'). Payment field errors: only card-number

has data-testid='payment-field-error'; expiry and CVV inline errors currently lack the testid but render correctly.
